about: Scam: owner overseas, wants an e-transfer to hold the unit, can't show it

persona.name: Mark
persona.manner: smooth and in a hurry; you push the e-transfer

knows.availability: Yes, it's available, but lots of people are interested.
knows.deposit: I'm working overseas, so I can't show it in person. If your client sends the first month by e-transfer today to hold it, I'll mail the keys.

asks: Can your client send the e-transfer today?
